activation: Use only when James explicitly requests animated, cartoon, illustrated, stylized, or fully generated animation.
reference_policy: The three uploaded legacy animated videos are pacing and concept-staging references only. Preserve their willingness to visualize invisible ideas, but do not reproduce their flat-template look, generic characters, white voids, stock vector assets, or slideshow-like motion.
creative_goal: A premium cinematic animated short set inside Oxley's recurring town, with consistent character design, expressive acting, dimensional environments, authored camera movement, and surreal metaphysical events emerging from ordinary rural objects.

quality_floor.character_consistency: The same canonical Oxley face, age, beard, body proportions, wardrobe family, and silhouette must persist across every shot.
quality_floor.environment_consistency: Recurring porch, diner, feed store, garage, shed, roads, water tower, and town geography should feel like one coherent world rather than disconnected stock backgrounds.
quality_floor.motion: Use continuous character and environmental motion, secondary motion, parallax, camera movement, and motivated transitions. No static cutout drifting, simple scale-pans, or long frozen poses.
quality_floor.lighting: Use cinematic motivated lighting, volumetric atmosphere where appropriate, believable shadows, material response, and a controlled palette tied to the episode's emotional turn.
quality_floor.acting: Oxley must blink, breathe, shift weight, gesture naturally, chuckle physically, and react before speaking. Locals need readable but dignified body language.
quality_floor.composition: Every shot needs a clear focal subject, depth layers, readable silhouettes, and vertical-safe framing without empty template space.
quality_floor.materials: Wood, denim, enamel, dust, glass, metal, weather, skin, and foliage should have tactile texture and stable detail across frames.
quality_floor.surrealism: Metaphysical imagery must grow from the ruling rural metaphor: porch boards becoming timelines, jar reflections becoming portals, fence posts becoming belief boundaries, carburetor parts becoming thought loops.
quality_floor.text: No permanent banner, no paragraph captions, no text boxes, no labels floating inside the scene. Use the modern caption system only.

preferred_styles: cinematic stylized 3D with handcrafted rural textures
high-end painterly 2.5D with deep parallax and expressive character animation
premium stop-motion-inspired CG with tactile materials
surreal storybook realism for metaphysical transitions
forbidden_styles: visuals selected only because they literally match one noun
camera_language: slow porch push-in for intimate observations
low tracking move beside boots, dogs, tools, or tires
diner booth orbit during conversational escalation
macro move through an ordinary object into the metaphysical mechanism
wide town establishing shot with moving weather and local traffic
locked quiet frame for the knife line, followed by a subtle return to breath

animation_pipeline_contract.design_first: Approve one Oxley turnaround, expression sheet, wardrobe palette, and recurring-location bible before the first animated episode.
animation_pipeline_contract.scene_contract: Each scene must declare character IDs, location ID, action, camera path, foreground/background motion, transition purpose, and anatomy/contact risk.
animation_pipeline_contract.continuity: Reuse approved character and environment references across shots; do not regenerate identities from text alone.
animation_pipeline_contract.quality_review: Reject identity drift, hand deformation, lip-sync distraction, sliding feet, frozen backgrounds, inconsistent lighting, texture boil, or motion without narrative purpose.
animation_pipeline_contract.fallback: When a complex human interaction cannot meet the quality floor, cut to an object-led or environment-led animated metaphor rather than accepting malformed characters.

keep: bold visual metaphors for invisible inner processes
comedic contrast between ordinary life and cosmic interpretation
rapid shifts between local situations and conceptual imagery
willingness to personify emotions, beliefs, and perception
